ud4.5:1.2: ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā kosambiyaṃ viharati ghositārāme.
ud4.5:1.3: tena kho pana samayena bhagavā ākiṇṇo viharati bhikkhūhi bhikkhunīhi upāsakehi upāsikāhi rājūhi rājamahāmattehi titthiyehi titthiyasāvakehi.
ud4.5:1.6: “ahaṃ kho etarahi ākiṇṇo viharāmi, bhikkhūhi bhikkhunīhi upāsakehi upāsikāhi rājūhi rājamahāmattehi titthiyehi titthiyasāvakehi.
ud4.5:2.1: atha kho bhagavā pubbanhasamayaṃ nivāsetvā pattacīvaramādāya kosambiyaṃ piṇḍāya pāvisi.
ud4.5:2.2: kosambiyaṃ piṇḍāya caritvā pacchābhattaṃ piṇḍapātapaṭikkanto sāmaṃ senāsanaṃ saṃsāmetvā pattacīvaramādāya anāmantetvā upaṭṭhāke, anapaloketvā bhikkhusaṅghaṃ, eko adutiyo yena pārileyyakaṃ tena cārikaṃ pakkāmi.
ud4.5:2.3: anupubbena cārikaṃ caramāno yena pārileyyakaṃ tadavasari.
ud4.5:2.4: tatrasudaṃ bhagavā pārileyyake viharati, rakkhitavanasaṇḍe bhaddasālamūle.
ud4.5:3.1: aññataro’pi kho hatthināgo ākiṇṇo viharati, hatthihi hatthinīhi hatthikalabhehi hatthicchāpehi. chinnaggāni ceva tiṇāni khādati. obhaggobhaggañcassa sākhābhaṅgaṃ khādanti. āvilāni ca pānīyāni pivati. ogāhā cassa uttiṇṇassa hatthiniyo kāyaṃ upanighaṃsantiyo gacchanti.
ud4.5:3.4: “ahaṃ kho etarahi ākiṇṇo viharāmi, hatthihi hatthinīhi hatthikalabhehi hatthicchāpehi.1 chinnaggāni ceva tiṇāni khādāmi. obhaggobhaggañca me sākhābhaṅgaṃ khādanti. āvilāni ca pānīyāni pivāmi. ogāhā ca me uttiṇṇassa hatthiniyo kāyaṃ upanighaṃsantiyo gacchanti. ākiṇṇo dukkhaṃ, na phāsu viharāmi.
ud4.5:4.1: atha kho so hatthināgo yūthā apakkamma yena pārileyyakaṃ rakkhitavanasaṇḍo bhaddasālamūlaṃ, yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami.
ud4.5:4.2: tatra sudaṃ so hatthināgo yasmiṃ padese bhagavā viharati, taṃ padesaṃ appabharitañca karoti, appaharitaṃ karoti, soṇḍāya bhagavato pānīyaṃ paribhojanīyañca upaṭṭhapeti.
ud4.5:5.1: atha kho bhagavato rahogatassa patisallīnassa evaṃ cetaso parivitakko udapādi:
ud4.5:5.2: “ahaṃ kho pubbe ākiṇṇo vihāsiṃ, bhikkhūhi bhikkhunīhi upāsakehi upāsikāhi rājūhi rājamahāmattehi titthiyehi titthiyasāvakehi, ākiṇṇo dukkhaṃ, na phāsu vihāsiṃ.
ud4.5:5.3: so’mhi etarahi anākiṇṇo viharāmi, bhikkhūhi bhikkhunīhi upāsakehi upāsikāhi rājūhi rājamahāmattehi titthiyehi titthiyasāvakehi. anākiṇṇo sukhaṃ phāsu viharāmī”ti.
ud4.5:6.1: tassapi kho hatthināgassa evaṃ cetaso parivitakko udapādi:
ud4.5:6.2: ahaṃ kho pubbe ākiṇṇo vihāsiṃ, hatthihi hatthinīhi hatthikalabhehi hatthicchāpehi. chinnaggāni ceva tiṇāni khādiṃ. obhaggobhaggañca me sākhābhaṅgaṃ khādiṃsu. āvilāni ca pānīyāni pivāsiṃ, ogāhā ca me uttiṇṇassa hatthiniyo kāyaṃ upanighaṃsantiyo agamaṃsu. ākiṇṇo dukkhaṃ na phāsu vihāsiṃ.
ud4.5:6.3: so’mhi etarahi anākiṇṇo viharāmi, hatthihi hatthinīhi hatthikalabhehi hatthicchāpehi. acchinnaggāni ceva tiṇāni khādāmi, obhaggobhaggañca me sākhābhaṅgaṃ na khādanti. anāvilāni ca pānīyāni pivāmi. ogāhā ca me uttiṇṇassa hatthiniyo na kāyaṃ upanighaṃsantiyo gacchanti, anākiṇṇo sukhaṃ phāsu viharāmī”ti.
ud4.5:7.1: atha kho bhagavā attano ca pavivekaṃ viditvā tassa ca hatthināgassa cetasā cetoparivitakkamaññāya tāyaṃ velāyaṃ imaṃ udānaṃ udānesi:
